hints.title: Index Separation
hints.text: For each index i, we need to inspect elements at indices at least x distance away.

hints.title: Dynamic Window Population
hints.text: As i advances from x to n - 1, insert nums[i - x] into a sorted structure.

hints.title: Binary Search Closest Values
hints.text: Query the sorted structure for the predecessor and successor of nums[i] using binary search, updating the global minimum difference.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorted list insertion and binary search lookup for constrained elements.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: All-pairs comparison checks O(n^2) pairs without index-ordered lookups.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory to store valid elements in the window.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintain a sorted structure of valid historical elements separated by at least x indices.
